# `Browser.MediaQuery`

[Back to stdlib index](../stdlib.md)

Ipe.Browser.MediaQuery — evaluate CSS media queries over `Ipe.Ffi.Js` ports.

A first-party proof of the per-capability web mechanism spanning BOTH port
directions: an outbound `JsCmd` requests a match (`match` one-shot or a
continuous `watch`), and an inbound `JsMsg` carries the reply — a decoded
`Bool` match result or a typed unavailability. Both cross the same seal codec
and fail-closed port discipline as every other port; there is no second
transport.

Importing this reserved `Ipe.Browser.<Api>` module discloses
`js-port:media-query` (import-derived, keyed on the canonical
`Ipe.Browser.MediaQuery` path prefix via `WebCapability::for_browser_module`,
alias-immune); only the top-level app's `[capabilities] accepts` set can grant
it.

The two layers:

  * `Ipe.Browser.MediaQuery.Internals` publishes the closed outbound/inbound ADTs.
  * this module is the high-level layer: `match_` returns a `Task Error Bool`
    via the correlated port→Task bridge; `watch` is `Cmd`-shaped, and `matches`
    is the inbound subscription folding the narrow `JsMsg` into a typed
    `Result Error Bool`. The inbound `case` is EXHAUSTIVE: an unavailability
    becomes a typed `Err`, never a silently dropped variant.

## `match_`

```ipe
match_ : String -> Task Error Bool
```

`match_ query` — evaluate a CSS media query string ONCE, as a
`Task Error Bool`.

`True` when the current environment matches the query; `False` when it does
not. Uses the correlated port→Task bridge (`Js.request`). A typed unavailability
resolves the `Task` with `Err`; no companion subscription is needed.

Importing this module discloses `js-port:media-query`; the app must grant it
with `accepts = [ JsPort MediaQuery ]` under [capabilities] in package.ipe.

## `watch`

```ipe
watch : String -> Cmd.Cmd msg
```

`watch query` — begin a CONTINUOUS match stream for `query`; each
`MediaQueryList.change` event delivers a fresh match result on the `matches`
subscription. Outbound `Cmd`.

## `matches`

```ipe
matches : (Result Error Bool -> msg) -> Sub.Sub msg
```

`matches toMsg` — the inbound subscription, wired in `subscriptions`.

The decoder IS the security gate: every inbound value runs through the total,
bounded seal decoder for the narrow `JsMsg`; a malformed / mismatched frame is
dropped whole. A decoded `JsMsg` is folded EXHAUSTIVELY into a
`Result Error Bool` — a `Matched` becomes `Ok`, an unavailability a typed `Err`.
